Cybersecurity: - Protects vehicle systems from unauthorized access and manipulation.
- Ensures integrity of software and communication systems.
- Regular updates maintain the protection level.
Over-the-air update: - Software updates are delivered automatically via mobile data.
- Update notifications appear in the infotainment system.
- Some updates may require confirmation or vehicle parked condition.
- Installation may take several minutes; follow system prompts.
Car2X communication: - Enables communication with other vehicles and infrastructure.
- Improves awareness of road hazards and traffic events.
- Warning messages are shown in the cockpit.
- Function depends on active mobile connection and compatibility.
CUPRA CONNECT: - Connects the vehicle to online services via mobile network.
- Includes remote control via app (e.g., lock/unlock, charging, A/C).
- Enables navigation with online traffic and point-of-interest data.
- Requires registration and activation via the CUPRA app or portal.
Privacy mode: - Allows the user to restrict or disable data transmission.
- Can be configured via infotainment system settings.
- May affect the availability of certain online services.
- Ideal when handing over the vehicle or for rental scenarios.
User administration: - Multiple user profiles can be stored in the system.
- Profiles include individual preferences and settings.
- Switching users updates climate, seat, and infotainment settings.
- Admin user can manage rights for other profiles.
WLAN access point: - The vehicle can provide internet access via mobile data.
- Devices can connect using WLAN to browse or stream.
- Configure access point settings from infotainment.
- Data charges may apply depending on provider.
Full Link: - Allows smartphone integration via Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, or MirrorLink.
- Connect via USB or wirelessly (depending on device).
- Apps and functions are displayed on the infotainment screen.
- Usage may depend on phone compatibility and regional availability.
Wired and wireless connections: - USB-C ports available in front and rear areas.
- Wireless phone charger may be present in the center console.
- Bluetooth enables hands-free calls and media streaming.
- Pairing devices requires confirmation on both sides for security.
